body.content:
# Epic: [Workstream] - Flow-[Flow Name]

## Flow Overview

- **Workstream**: [Your workstream - e.g., Testing, Security, etc.]
- **Problem Statement**: [What manual process does this flow automate?]
- **User Story**: As a [role], I want [capability] so that [benefit]


## Flow Details

- **Primary Agents**: [Which agents will orchestrate this flow]
- **Tools/MCP Dependencies**: [What tools/systems does this flow need]
- **Human-in-the-Loop Points**: [Where does the flow need human approval]
- **Success Criteria**: [How do you measure successful flow execution]


## Implementation Plan
- [ ] Agent coordination logic
- [ ] Tool integration requirements  
- [ ] HITL approval points
- [ ] Error handling and rollback
- [ ] Testing and validation

## Links

- [ ] **Parent Epic**: [Link to this main R&D Enablement epic]
- [ ] **Related Tool Issues**: [Link individual tool/integration issues]
